---
title: "hpa_quarto"
author: "Arisa Tani"
---

I am comparing the total number of genes with regionally elevated expression in the forebrain in three species: human, pig and mouse.

```{r}
total_human <- sum(180, 83, 57, 110)
print(paste("Human:", total_human))

total_pig <- sum(109, 157, 31, 45)
print(paste("Pig:", total_pig))

total_mouse <- sum(55, 185, 60, 98)
print(paste("Mouse:", total_mouse))
```

Humans had the most genes regionally elevated in the forebrain.
